title: refactor(metadata-protocol): move the row-less expanded view read and the own-name container expansion out of protocol.ts into protocol-view-expansion-names.ts (#25467 cut 22)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7JKgiM29GUcitRvoGGj5BU)_

Part of #25467
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6270097840

Cut 22 of the `protocol.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). Cuts 1–21 landed as #25494, #25518, #25538, #25589, #25601, #25623, #25642, #25719, #25731, #25740, #25797, #25939, #25972, #26014, #26104, #26168, #26264, #26317, #26350, #26366 and #26404. The claim is `6432922305`. The scope is the cut 22 proposal of the cut 21 report (`6432160640`), which the server seat approved in its dispatch order, with the order's condition that the read-seam census stays at 82 with an identical list. Both members passed the AST screen and the census trial, and both moved unedited.

Two `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` members move unedited into a new module, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-view-expansion-names.ts` (#23050 shape B):

- `resolveRowlessExpandedView`: the by-name read's answer for a view name that no stored row holds but a stored view container expands (#21442). It is the list read's own answer by construction: the same rows, parse, expansion and selection (#21967).
- `expandUnderOwnName`: the expansion of a container on another package's object under the container's own name (#21334, #21980).

`protocol.ts` loses 39 net lines (29,193 to 29,154). The cut is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts.

Branch `claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` is the harness-pinned branch for this thread. It was restarted from `main` `9a0108cdc2` after cut 21 merged. It names no issue, so the claim comment is the identity record. It holds the move commit `c2087b4c49` and the merge of `main` (`95673433d1`). That merge touches no file of `packages/metadata-protocol/`: the package's `src/` tree is `ac8309b0` at the move commit and at the merge.

## Serial with the file's in-flight PRs

Measured just before this PR was opened, against the merged head `95673433d1`: of the 20 open PRs, **none edits `protocol.ts`** and none names either member. Two touch `packages/metadata-protocol/src/` test files: **#26337** (3 files) and **#26138** (7 files). Each was checked with `git merge-tree`: both are clean against this head and against `origin/main` alone. No open PR edits the new module.

## The order's screen (private statics, `new Error(`, the read-seam census)

Both members passed:

- **No private-static read.** The AST walk found no access on the `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` identifier and none on `this.constructor`.
- **No error constructed.** Neither body has `new Error(`, so no `PRODUCERS` row is owed.
- **Read-seam census** (added to the screen after cut 21). Each member was moved alone to a scratch module in a clean worktree and `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` re-run: 82 read seams and an identical list for each. The real cut measures the same; see "The durability `--list`".

## What moves

| Member | Base line | Visibility | Body lines | AST tokens (params + return + body) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `resolveRowlessExpandedView` | `:10306` | private async | 27 | 232 |
| `expandUnderOwnName` | `:18159` | private | 28 | 297 |

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1–21 apply it)

- **The class keeps both members.** Each keeps its name, docblock, signature and position. Each body now delegates, marked `[#25467 cut 22]`.
- **Typing.** `ViewExpansionNamesHost` types each of its six members as the class member itself (`ObjectStackProtocolImplementation['…']`). Each function types its `this` as the `Pick` of the members it reads. Each stub annotates its literal as `ThisParameterType<typeof fn>`. No member changes visibility.
- **Members read, measured by AST walk** (property and element accesses on `this`, with `as` casts, parentheses and `!` stripped, and bare `this` checked too). All are methods, each handed over as a closure `(...a) => this.x(...a)`:
  - `resolveRowlessExpandedView` reads `readActiveOverlayRows`, `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned`, `namesWithOwnStoredRow`, `expandStoredViewContainers` and `storedOverlayEntries`. Three of these are themselves cut 16 stubs, so the call reaches `protocol-stored-overlay-reads.ts` through the class, as before. `expandStoredViewContainers` is generic (`<E …>`); its closure is contextually typed by the class member, and `tsc` accepts it with no annotation.
  - `expandUnderOwnName` reads `isShippedByAnotherPackage`.
- **Every caller still calls the class method.** There are four `this.resolveRowlessExpandedView(` sites (`:11041`, `:11556`, `:22145`, `:27291` at base) and one `this.expandUnderOwnName(` site (`:18008`, inside `expandRuntimeViewContainer`). None changes.

## Module-level declarations, by reader

Measured by an AST walk over each body's identifiers, against `protocol.ts`'s top-level declarations and import bindings (property names excluded):

| Name | Where `protocol.ts` has it | Other readers in `protocol.ts` | What this cut does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RowlessExpandedView` | non-exported interface, `:6254` | yes (2) | gains `export` in place; the new module imports it as a type |
| `servedViewExpansion` | non-exported generic function, `:2872` | yes (2) | gains `export` in place; the new module imports it from `./protocol.js` |
| `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` | the `@objectstack/spec/shared` import | yes (59) | stays; the new module imports it from there too |
| `expandViewContainer` | the `@objectstack/spec/ui` import | yes (2) | stays; imported from there too |

`index.ts` names its exports one by one, so the two in-place `export`s do not reach the published surface (cuts 8, 11, 18 and 19 did the same). The one new statement in `protocol.ts` is the import of the new module.

## The durability `--list`

`check-durability-degradation-log-level` exits 0 at both ends with identical output: `82 read seam(s)` at both ends, the order's condition. Its `--list` is **identical once `[@:][0-9]+` is stripped** (158 lines, and no entry changes file). No entry of the base `--list` names either member. `resolveRowlessExpandedView`'s `try` guards `this.readActiveOverlayRows(...)`, which is already a cut 16 stub, and the gate did not count it as a read seam at base either. Its `catch` rethrows through `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` (#5532), unedited. On the merged tree the verdict still reads `82 read seam(s)`.

## The published `.d.ts`

The series bar is ruling `6348891160`: sorted-union identity, measured first, with raw identity reported when it holds. **Both hold for this cut.**

Base `9a0108cdc2` and head `c2087b4c49` were built with `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build` against one dependency tree. The closure was built at head by a full `pnpm build` (118/118). For the base build, the package's `src/` was swapped tree-only to base and restored from `HEAD` under a trap. Afterwards `git diff HEAD` was empty, `git status` was clean, and both touched blobs equalled `HEAD`'s.

- **Normalised sha256** (the ruling's bar): `0a7694d518b570981c5cdcbcdd8fcb2dec9f1c7d74a7287299fe9e19e32a4183` at both ends, on `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts`. The normaliser sorted 80 string-literal union runs. **Sorted-union identity holds.**
- **Raw sha256**: `059fa1189ac13c65c36d3718584495bebaa48cc545e1526adb37cd95ef7dfaa3` at both ends, 777,645 bytes. **Raw identity holds.**
- **Again on the merged tree** `95673433d1` (closure rebuilt by a full `pnpm build`, 118/118): the same raw and normalised sha256 and the same `index.js`/`index.cjs` hashes as the pre-merge head.
- **The two builds differ where they should.**
  - `index.js` hashes `dbff5f6c5cde69ca…` at base and `14cc3ee05da5713f…` at head (`index.cjs` `919b8129becaf027…` → `c75e50d7513a93c9…`).
  - Each function's `.call(host` site occurs 0 times in the base bundles and once in the head bundles (ESM and CJS alike), and each `function NAME(` declaration goes 0 → 1.
- **Positive control** on the head tree. `private` was dropped from `expandUnderOwnName` on disk (restored from `HEAD` under a trap) and the package rebuilt. Both `.d.ts` files move to `796c09174d25bb97…` (normalised `9f5a865eb21c4211…`, which differs from the bar's `0a7694d5…`) and print `expandUnderOwnName(type: string, object: string, container: Record<string, any>, ownPackageId: string | undefined): Record<string, unknown>[];`. So the bar can see a change on these members.
- **Export tables.** The ESM and CJS bundles, loaded at runtime from the package, each export the same 78 names at base and head. The sorted list hashes to `9f18a0177ac736ed…` on all of them. None of the moved functions, `ViewExpansionNamesHost`, `servedViewExpansion` or `RowlessExpandedView` appears.

No changeset: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160`.

## Proof of move-only

**Bodies, by AST token.** The compare reads the TypeScript compiler's AST leaf tokens, with JSDoc skipped, over the parameters (less the added `this`), the return type and the body. It compares base `protocol.ts` at `9a0108cdc2` against the head module:

```
resolveRowlessExpandedView: base tokens 232, head tokens 232, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
expandUnderOwnName: base tokens 297, head tokens 297, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
TOTAL tokens=529 differ=0 members=2
CLASS members base=301 head=301 order-same=true byte-identical=299 stubs-with-identical-docblock+signature=2 other=[]
TOP base=250 head=251 byte-identical=248
```

The two top-level statements that are not byte-identical are `servedViewExpansion` and `RowlessExpandedView`, which gained `export` and nothing else.

**Negative controls**, one per member, each one token changed in an in-memory copy of the head module:

```
MUTATED … "!== 'view') return undefined" -> "=== 'view') return undefined"
resolveRowlessExpandedView: base tokens 232, head tokens 232, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
expandUnderOwnName: base tokens 297, head tokens 297, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
MUTATED … "item.name = under;" -> "item.name = ownName;"
resolveRowlessExpandedView: base tokens 232, head tokens 232, differ 0, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) true
expandUnderOwnName: base tokens 297, head tokens 297, differ 1, text-equal(ws-collapsed, comments incl.) false
```

- **Class side.** There are 301 members at base and at head, in the same order. The 299 that did not move are byte-identical to base, leading comments included. Both stubs sit at their base positions and keep their docblocks and signatures byte-identical.
- **Top level of `protocol.ts`.** Of the 250 base statements, 248 are byte-identical, leading comments included; the other two gained `export`. Head adds one statement, the new module's import.
- **Size.** +143 / −57 over 2 files, 200 changed lines (the proposal's estimate was 200–260). `protocol-view-expansion-names.ts` has 125 lines.

## Readers of the moved lines

The tests and scripts that read `protocol.ts` by path (33 files that name `protocol.ts` and call `readFileSync`) were grepped for both member names and for the bodies' text: `servedViewExpansion`, `RowlessExpandedView`, `expandViewContainer(`, `standInRows`, `underIsShipped`, `bareSpelled`. So were the test files in `packages/`, `docs/qa/` and the `@objectstack/spec` liveness ledgers.

- **By path: none reads the moved bodies.** No by-path reader matches any of those strings.
- **No test names either member.** The behaviour is driven through the class by the view-container expansion tests in the package suite, which pass at both ends.
- **The liveness ledgers.** No row points at either member. Carried forward: `manifest.json`'s `dependencies` row → `protocol.ts#resolveWritePackageScope` (cut 19) and `seed.json` → `protocol.ts#applySeedBodies` (cut 14) still quote lines that moved to a seam module. `check:liveness` checks only that the `#symbol` is named in the file, and both stubs keep it. Re-pointing them is a `packages/spec/**` edit, outside this card.
- **ADR anchors.** `check-adr-anchors` gives identical output at both ends (1,876 decision letters, 59,344 citations across 8,385 files). Neither body nor the new header cites an ADR.
- **Engine-double contract** (`check-engine-double-contract`): exits 0 at both ends. The `updateData`/`deleteData` seams keep their entries at new line numbers (13898 → 13882, 13923 → 13907). `productionFiles` is 3,764 at base and 3,766 at head: the new file, and the gitignored `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts` the spec build writes in the head tree (as in cuts 20 and 21).
- **Identical output at both ends:** `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-query-options-erasure-ratchet`, `check-filter-alias-parity` and `check-durability-degradation-log-level`. `check-nul-bytes` differs only in the scanned file count, +1. The base-end readings were taken in a clean detached worktree at `9a0108cdc2`.

## Verification

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 at head and on the merged tree.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config packages/metadata-protocol` exits 0 with no output (the whole touched package, with the root `lint` script's flags).
- **`packages/metadata-protocol` suite**, base and head, compared per test name and status. Each leg ran vitest `--maxWorkers=2` with the JSON reporter under the shared verify lock.
  - Base `9a0108cdc2`: 21,584 tests (21,565 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 271 files.
  - Head `c2087b4c49`: 21,584 tests (21,565 passed, 0 failed, 19 skipped), 271 files.
  - None lost, none added, none changed status. The base leg is the package `src/` swapped tree-only from `9a0108cdc2` (the new module removed) and restored from `HEAD` under a trap.
  - The merged head `95673433d1` gives the same 21,584 tests, per test identical to the pre-merge head (0 lost, 0 added, 0 changed).
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main` (merged tree): OK. 1 anchored file is in the change set, 29 anchors were judged, and 0 were lost.
- **Governed surface.** `check-governed-merges --branch claude/project-thread-ybjm3h` finds 0 of 2 paths in the register (13 surfaces), so the PR is NOT governed. It has 200 changed lines, under the 3,000-line human-merge bar.
- **Derived gates.** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 46 gates on 2 changed paths from the merged tree `95673433d1`, with no stale-tree warning; all 46 exit 0 after the full `pnpm build` (118/118). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 46 derived, 46 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0. When this PR was opened, `main` was one commit past the merge (`ui/packages/app-shell` and a changeset), with no stale-tree warning.
- `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list` on the merged tree: `82 read seam(s)`, the list identical to the pre-merge head's.

## Carry-forward

These stay in `protocol.ts`:

- **The read-seam members** (cut 21): a member named in a `protocol.ts` read-seam entry of `check-durability-degradation-log-level --list`, as guarded wrapper or guarding member, stays until the gate follows imported wrappers or a ruling accepts the loss. The census trial on this base measured `findEnvironmentRows` 82 → 66, `packagelessAddress` → 78, `findServedOverlayRow` → 79, and `foldStoredCollection`, `applyObjectRegistryMutation`, `unmanagedImportCollisions`, `rollBackUnmanagedImport`, `readRevertableCommit` and `storedFlowBindingAgrees` → 81. `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` cannot move at all: moved alone, the gate exits 1 and finds 3 read seams.
- Public members whose return type is inferred.
- The bodies kept by a reader: `probeRecord`, `getMetaItemCached`, `findReferencesToMeta`, `refuseUnmintableMetaType`, `metaTypeNamespaceExists`, `viewContainerNameCollisionRefusal` with `overlaidShippedContainerViewNames`, `reportPageRequiresAbsentAtLoad`, the 7 `applyRegistryWriteThrough` callers, `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` and `ensureObjectStorage`.
- The private-static readers: `refusePackagedBaseRemoval`, `packagedBaseRefusal`, `runPublishSideEffects`, `promoteDraftForPublish`, `publishPackageDrafts` and `discardPackageDrafts`.
- The field writers: `warnClosureReadUnavailable`.
